slide1.title: "We'll let you know."
slide1.body: They all say it. But you'll keep track of who actually meant it — and who just vanished.

slide2.title: Every interview, every reply
slide2.body: Calendar, notifications, and deadlines. Always know who still owes you an answer and for how long.

slide3.title: Ghosting detected.
slide3.body: If a company goes silent for 60 days, we'll know. We archive it automatically so you can move on.

slide4.title: Job hunting is a race.
slide4.body: Every application earns XP. Every interview unlocks badges. The offer is the final boss — and this time, you'll win. 🎉

slide5.title: Already have applications?
slide5.body: No problem — download our Excel template from the Profile, fill it in, and upload it. The app populates itself! 🚀
